name: REAL / $REAL
tagline: One zk token for every app, three years before Rei
summary: REAL is the unifying coin of the archive: the endgame vehicle of the 2022 Olympus plan, an "algorithmic REAL" stablecoin in 2023, and in June 2025, with James Piazza, a zk Layer 1 without consensus whose single $REAL token earns a share of app revenue, plus a separate Solana token paying 5–15% from real-world assets. Rei keeps its one-token, one-login, handle-centred design and reverses its economics: no yield, revenue share or buybacks.

name: "Market" token rules
tagline: Tokens priced like shares; the property sale is the token sale
summary: Saheb's written rules for how a token should trade: low float, short vesting, a $40 target price, a split above $500, bonds and reverse splits. Real estate is sold with tokens attached, so the property sale is the token sale, and every raise lifts valuation by three times its size. Ideas (Sep 2023) generalizes it: crypto becomes the main equity of internet companies.

name: Operation 100b & the trading books
tagline: Option parlays — and the first "Perpetuals on Stocks" line
summary: Saheb's trade plans written as parlays: a $500k ETH put-spread chain to $62.5m (2022), a $10M book claiming over $100B notional (2023), an options path to a $100M net worth, and a 3-leg ETH call-spread "mission" to 7200 (2024). Operation 100b ends with "Perpetuals on Stocks, Cheaper than Options on Stocks", 32 months before Greyline, and lists the counterparty terms that central clearing later solves.
